A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TinySQL study and contain the main text and Appendices A–M. Text, equations, figures and tables support reliable comparison, including material relocated within the appendices.

before.justification: v4 reports original fine-tuning accuracies, circuit recovery experiments, ablations and logit-lens analyses, including Tables 2–3 and 8 and the appendix results.

after.justification: v5 reports these original empirical outcomes, including model accuracies in Table 8, circuit recovery results and appendix ablation and case-study findings.

M1.justification: The dataset-generation procedure, BM1–BM3 models, EAP circuit selection and ablation procedures, and SAE identification algorithm remain unchanged. Explicit Syn labels clarify existing configurations.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation coverage is unchanged. Filtering and joins were already described and evaluated in v4 (Section 3 and Table 13). Their addition to Figure 1 and its seven-to-nine subset correction update the overview rather than introduce new tasks.

E2.justification: The same EAP, SAE and random-circuit comparisons remain in Tables 4 and 18, alongside the same base-model and fine-tuned-model comparisons. Expanded model names do not introduce new comparators.

E3.justification: Both retain the same data splits, training budgets, model configurations, exact-match and recovered-accuracy metrics, and EAP/SAE evaluation procedures. No experimental setting is substantively revised.

E4.justification: Input-corruption studies, activation-patching examples, attention/MLP/full-layer ablations, random-circuit checks and logit-lens case studies are retained. Relocated appendix displays contain the same analyses.

E5.justification: Batching and repetition descriptions and statistical reporting practices are unchanged. v5 adds no seed information, confidence intervals, uncertainty-estimation procedures or significance tests.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Table 8 retains BM1's 85.63% accuracy on CS3_Syn, and Table 13 retains 82.19% and 70.00% circuit recovery for CS4 and CS5. Table-label corrections do not add or replace result entries.

T1.justification: The EAP attribution expression, Equation 1, SAE objective, Algorithm 1 mathematics and local-minimality description retain their meaning. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or substantively revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: a progressive TinySQL testbed, complementary circuit analyses and layerwise SQL-generation findings. Their scientific scope and strength are unchanged.

C2.justification: Both retain the same SQL-generation interpretation, robustness–granularity tradeoff and limitations concerning EAP scalability, ablation sensitivity and incomplete circuit recovery. Appendix interpretations also remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v4 provides direct GitHub and Hugging Face links for code, datasets, models and SAEs. v5 replaces these with a project-website link advertising code, data, models and viewers. This changes access instructions; the PDFs do not establish changes to hosted artifacts. Implementation details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to interpretability methods and text-to-SQL datasets remain unchanged. The new acknowledgements do not substantively revise research positioning.

P1.justification: v5 adds acknowledgements and venue text, revises contribution and correspondence details, standardizes Syn terminology and makes small textual corrections. The main narrative and section organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is redrawn to depict existing filtering/join coverage and changes its caption from seven to nine subsets, although both new lower rows incorrectly say CS3-Syn. Tables 4–5 receive clearer model labels, and appendix floats move, including Figure 12 from page 22 to page 25. Other plotted content is retained.

improvement.justification: Clearer model identification in Tables 4–5, especially replacing Table 4's ambiguous CS label, modestly improves traceability of the comparisons. Figure 1 also more fully depicts the existing dataset coverage, although its new filtering/join rows introduce incorrect CS3-Syn labels. These limited documentation gains outweigh that localized error; scientific evidence and limitations remain unchanged.
